title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Improper per-form authorization for field management in Visforms extension…
description: The Visforms extension for Joomla versions 1.0.0-5.6.4 and 6.0.0-6.2.1 contains an improper per-form authorization vulnerability. This flaw allows backend users to manage fields of forms other than those they are authorized for, due to permission checks being performed against a user-supplied form ID rather than the actual form the field belongs to.
